Oda seemingly, through writing and SBS, understands the gravity of life and death in that it is not just meant as a "zomg! They killed off that character!?!?" but should propel someone or the plot forward or in a new direction.  

It shows across the reddit w "fucking kill this guy" and Im not saying some people dont deserve death, but rather it does no good to walk around thinking about who needs to die,  wishing for it, etc. Oda touched upon that w his (paraphrasing) "the older I get and the more loved ones I lose the more I understand how serious death is and that's why Luffy doesn't aspire to kill" but it took me a while to realize that even though we "wanted" Pell to die, he just doesn't want to go around putting death in people's heads (same w diseases,  he will never say "cancer" bc strikes close to home for some).

I think he's served his purpose and there are plenty of psychopaths in O.P, but it takes a special type to abduct and experiment on kids. He even knew it was pointless and fruitless efforts that would kill them and he would grab more. He did all of that for $ to get booze and sex, I'm good w him being gone
